name: The Gorrillo Bandits
description: Bandits who hold the Old Prison, a ruin in the Bonefields, and roam the Bonefields and Flats Lagoon, hostile to all they meet. All but their leader Gorrillo, a huge man called the Boulder, fight bare-handed in gi and light armour. Gorrillo is wanted in the Shek Kingdom and in the United Cities for robbery and assault in Mourn.
